guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: “Our third quarter financial performance demonstrates the durability of our business model and our ability to generate sustainable growth, margin expansion and strong free cash flow,” said Josh Whipple, chief financial officer. “We remain focused on driving commercial excellence, realizing the benefits of our increased scale and rigorous integration execution as we build on the financial strength of the combined company.”

Whipple continued, “Our full year outlook is unchanged. We continue to expect normalized1, constant currency adjusted net revenue growth of approximately 4% – 5% and adjusted earnings per share of $13.60 – $13.80 for the full year. We continue to expect normalized1 adjusted operating margin expansion of approximately 150 basis points for the full year and to return more than $2 billion of capital to shareholders in 2026.”
